name: Joined_Invoice_Product
description: A flattened invoice dataset with one row for each product line. Invoice-level details repeat for every product belonging to the same invoice.

fields.name: invoice_item_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for a product row, generated by combining invoice_number and line_number, for example LU-LBR-2026-0801-1.

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Invoice identifier shared by all product rows extracted from the same invoice.

fields.name: line_number
fields.description: Position of the product within the invoice line-item table.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Date on which the invoice was issued.

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Final date by which the invoice should be paid.

fields.name: purchase_order_number
fields.description: Customer purchase-order reference shown on the invoice.

fields.name: seller_name
fields.description: Legal name of the company selling the products.

fields.name: seller_address
fields.description: Registered or billing address of the seller.

fields.name: seller_gstin
fields.description: GST identification number of the seller.

fields.name: seller_email
fields.description: Email address provided by the seller for billing communication.

fields.name: seller_phone
fields.description: Contact phone number of the seller.

fields.name: buyer_name
fields.description: Legal or trading name of the customer purchasing the products.

fields.name: buyer_address
fields.description: Billing address of the buyer.

fields.name: buyer_gstin
fields.description: GST identification number of the buyer.

fields.name: place_of_supply
fields.description: State or jurisdiction used to determine the applicable GST treatment.

fields.name: product_sku
fields.description: Seller-assigned stock-keeping code for the product.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Name of the lumber product or related material sold on this invoice line.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Detailed product information such as timber species, grade, treatment, thickness or finish.

fields.name: product_category
fields.description: High-level product group such as timber, plywood, MDF, veneer, flooring, adhesive or wood finish.

fields.name: hsn_code
fields.description: HSN classification code used for the product's tax treatment.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Quantity of the product sold on this invoice line.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of measurement, such as Cft, Sft, Rft, Sheet, Nos, Set, Can or Pail.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Selling price for one unit of the product before tax.

fields.name: product_discount
fields.description: Discount amount applied specifically to this product line.

fields.name: product_taxable_amount
fields.description: Value of the product line on which tax is calculated, after any line-level discount.

fields.name: product_line_amount
fields.description: Total value of the product row before invoice-level tax, generally quantity multiplied by unit_price minus discount.

fields.name: invoice_subtotal
fields.description: Sum of all product line amounts in the complete invoice before tax.

fields.name: invoice_discount_total
fields.description: Total discount applied across the complete invoice.

fields.name: tax_type
fields.description: Tax structure applied to the invoice, such as CGST_SGST, IGST or NONE.

fields.name: cgst_rate
fields.description: Central GST percentage applied to the invoice for an intrastate sale.

fields.name: cgst_amount
fields.description: Total Central GST amount charged on the complete invoice.

fields.name: sgst_rate
fields.description: State GST percentage applied to the invoice for an intrastate sale.

fields.name: sgst_amount
fields.description: Total State GST amount charged on the complete invoice.

fields.name: igst_rate
fields.description: Integrated GST percentage applied to the invoice for an interstate sale.

fields.name: igst_amount
fields.description: Total Integrated GST amount charged on the complete invoice.

fields.name: total_tax_amount
fields.description: Combined tax amount charged on the complete invoice.

fields.name: round_off_amount
fields.description: Rounding adjustment applied when calculating the final invoice total.

fields.name: invoice_total_amount
fields.description: Final amount payable for the complete invoice including taxes and adjustments.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency used for all monetary values, such as INR.

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Conditions defining when the invoice must be paid, such as Net 15 days.

fields.name: payment_status
fields.description: Current payment state of the invoice, such as unpaid, partially paid, paid, overdue or cancelled.

fields.name: invoice_notes
fields.description: Additional payment, delivery, warranty or invoice instructions.
